title: ARCHER PRINCESS DUCK
storyTitleEn: Ancient Egyptian princesses were buried with weapons. Their bones reveal why
storyTitleJa: Ancient Egyptian princesses were buried with weapons. Their bones reveal why
imageAltEn: The Daily Duck yellow duck mascot for Archer Princess Duck
imageAltJa: Archer Princess DuckをテーマにしたThe Daily Duckの黄色いダック
storyEn: Ancient Egyptian princesses were buried with weapons, and their bones reveal a fascinating story. Analysis of their remains shows that these royal women were active archers and hunters rather than passive figures.
storyJa: 古代エジプトの王女たちは武器とともに埋葬されており、その骨は興味深い事実を物語っています。遺骨の分析によると、これらの王族の女性たちは受動的な存在ではなく、自ら弓を引き、狩りを行うアクティブな人物であったことが分かりました。
duckEn: Royal archers showing us that history is full of surprises!
duckJa: 歴史は驚きに満ちているアヒルね！
